YOUR COMMITMENT CAN TAKE MANY FORMS

Five ways to work with us.

Propose a partnership
01

Host interns

Every programme includes a two- to four-month company internship. By hosting an intern, you meet a future employee already trained in the core skills of your trade, supervised by a mentor from your team and followed by an institute trainer. We plan the internship with you: tasks, duration, objectives and assessment.

02

Recruit our learners

Looking for a tiler, a hairdresser, an electrician or an accounting assistant? Send us your job offers: we will introduce you to trained, motivated candidates who match your needs. We stay in touch during the first weeks to help them settle in.

03

Contribute to training

Your professionals can act as trainers or jury members, run a workshop demonstration or host a company visit. You can also help update the curriculum, or provide equipment and consumables. These contributions bring training closer to real working conditions.

04

Support young entrepreneurs

Many learners want to open their own workshop, salon or small business. The institute helps them build their project: a simple market study, start-up cost estimates, finding first customers. As a partner, you can sponsor a project, become a mentor, subcontract work or ease access to equipment and microcredit.

05

Support the Foundation

The Foundation removes the financial barriers that prevent motivated young people from training: tuition fees, tools, transport. Your donations, in cash or in kind, fund scholarships and starter kits given to learners at the end of their programme.

THE RACINES D'AVENIR FOUNDATION

No talent should be left behind for lack of means.

To enable motivated young people, whatever their means, to learn a trade and start their working life.

Its objectives

  • Fund training scholarships
  • Equip the institute's workshops
  • Provide starter kits for young entrepreneurs
  • Promote women's access to technical trades

Its actions

  • Scholarships awarded on the basis of social situation and motivation
  • Tool kits handed out at the end of training
  • Collection of donations in cash and in kind
  • Mentoring by volunteer professionals

RACINES D'AVENIRVocational Training Institute

A vocational training institute based in Yaoundé, Racines d'Avenir trains young people and adults for in-demand trades in construction, tailoring, beauty, services and digital technology.

Our mission: to train, support and place every learner, all the way to a job or a business of their own.
